style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire, comic horror
anatomy: EXACTLY four legs, two front two back; a leg hidden behind a tag is hidden, not replaced
motion_rule: 12 movements in 10 seconds, every one HERS — a hoof, the neck, the body. Camera and swarm move on top of her movement, never instead. She is in frame in every beat
camera_moves: each beat has its own move and shot size
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge eyes, stand-up comic
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, yellow square pupils, a fan of coupons and a flute; he crosses the lens, never hides her
props: TAGS: price tags with butterfly wings, each a different bright colour, a big embossed currency sign, no words
coat: the tags DO land on her and stay, more each beat — by 7.0 she is buried to the eyes, each still beating its wings
environment: sunlit alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; horror is in the teeth

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.8-3.35 ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 1.95 or 2.65; 5.0-7.0 ONE unbroken phrase across 5.9; voiceless after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a fairground pan flute all clip, wind in grass, a sharp CLICK at 8.6, then flute alone

timeline.a: silent. HOOK: she charges low through the grass, drops her buck-toothed face into the lens and slams one hoof to her chest; the camera charges to meet her
she rocks her whole body at the lens and stamps both front hooves in turn, while the camera tilts up her neck and the GOAT gallops past behind
no break. She snaps her head right after the goat, neck whipping across frame, and the camera whips with her as his fan wipes the lens
no break. She throws her head up and kicks a back leg out, her flank wiping the lens as the camera swings back left
silent. She rears onto her back legs mid-frame, front hooves punching the air, as a swarm of BRIGHT tags erupts off the flowers around her
silent. She bucks and twists inside the swarm; the first tags latch onto her neck and stay, wings still beating
one scarlet tag lands flat on the lens; she shakes her head hard and flings it off her nose as the camera pushes in on her eyes
no break, phrase runs on. She wheels on the spot, stamping, while tag after tag latches on till only her eyes show, and the camera orbits a full turn
silent. She spins inside the finished coat and kicks out with both back legs, every tag beating its wings as the camera pulls back
silent. She cranes her neck to her own flank, ears flattening, as every tag turns at once: bodies swell into goggle-eyed PIRANHA heads with sharp teeth
silent. CLICK: every piranha bites at once, she jolts up with all four hooves off the ground and the camera hauls back
silent. She rears back, eyes blowing wide in comic horror, grin frozen, piranhas raining past as the camera drives in

must_appear: the alpaca in every shot, a thick coat of tags clinging to her by 7.0, every tag turning into a piranha with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror
negative_prompt: letters, cyrillic, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, people, hands, live insects, blood, a second alpaca, five legs, an extra limb, deformed anatomy, slow motion, static camera, the alpaca standing still, the alpaca absent from frame, tags flying past without clinging, a motionless coat, a talking head with an empty frame, accented Russian
